chapter.heading: A Psalm of thanksgiving.
chapter.v:
Shout for
joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

Serve Yahweh
with gladness.Come before his presence with singing.

Know that
Yahweh, he is God.It is he who has made us, and we are his.We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

Enter into
his gates with thanksgiving,and into his courts with praise.Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

For Yahweh
is good.His loving kindness endures forever,his faithfulness to all generations.
